The `memcmp` calls use `sizeof(exr_attr_box2i_t)`, `sizeof(float)`, `sizeof(exr_attr_timecode_t)`, `sizeof(exr_attr_chromaticities_t)`.

The vulnerability: if an attribute is parsed but its data is not properly initialized/allocated (e.g., the attribute exists but the data pointer references out-of-bounds or uninitialized memory), then `memcmp` reads from that bad memory.
